verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only a single asynchronous email send endpoint that returns one `x-message-id`, plus merge-field personalization. Nothing shows a bulk or batch endpoint that accepts many personalized messages in one request and returns per-message status. Per-email status lookup and personalization are adjacent features and do not show batch sending.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send a batch of personalized emails in a single API request with per-message status in the response, instead of looping one call per recipient
